quote: This replication-based study has allowed us to validate the results of Rellensmann and Schukajlow (2017) and also to complement, discuss and refine them with new results (Star, 2018). ... In addition, we have adapted the original study with a sample of pre-service teachers. This part of the present study has allowed us to find that pre-service teachers are more interested in problems connected to reality. These results complement those of the original study; indeed, they might explain why pre-service teachers overestimate the interest of students in this type of problems (Rellensmann & Schukajlow, 2017).
